section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measurement of consideration of cosmetic surgery using the Consider subscale of the ACSS (Appearance Concern and Cosmetic Surgery Scale), which consists of five items rated on a 7-point Likert scale. The subscale demonstrates high internal consistency (Cronbach's alpha = .92 in the present study) and has been validated in previous research for assessing the likelihood that respondents would consider having cosmetic surgery.
